summary: This is a user account settings screen for the Nimbus project management app, allowing users to update their profile information (full name, work email) and configure notification preferences.

stack.name: Next.js (App Router)
stack.why: Provides React frontend, API routes, and SSR out of the box in a unified full-stack framework.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Enables rapid styling with utility classes matching the precise color and typography tokens.

stack.name: Prisma + PostgreSQL (Neon)
stack.why: Type-safe ORM paired with a free serverless PostgreSQL database.

stack.name: NextAuth.js
stack.why: Simple session management and credentials/OAuth auth flow for securing profile endpoints.

stack.name: Vercel
stack.why: Zero-config deployment for Next.js web applications with serverless API support.

steps.title: Initialize project and install dependencies
steps.detail: Create a new Next.js TypeScript project with Tailwind CSS and install Prisma and lucide-react icons.
steps.code:
npx create-next-app@latest nimbus --typescript --tailwind --app
cd nimbus
npm install @prisma/client next-auth lucide-react
npm install -D prisma
steps.check: Local dev server boots up with 'npm run dev' without errors.

steps.title: Configure design tokens and Tailwind theme
steps.detail: Define the custom colors for background, surface, text, and accent in tailwind.config.ts to match the spec.
steps.check: Verify background colors render #0d1528 on the sidebar and #f8fafc on the main panel.

steps.title: Define Prisma schema for user profile and settings
steps.detail: Create models for User and UserPreferences storing full name, email, and toggle states in prisma/schema.prisma.
steps.code:
model User {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  fullName        String
  email           String   @unique
  emailDueDates   Boolean  @default(true)
  weeklySprint    Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
}

steps.title: Create Profile API Route and Connect with Client
steps.detail: Implement app/api/user/profile/route.ts to handle GET and PUT requests, validating body data and persisting updates via Prisma.
steps.check: Clicking 'Save changes' sends a PUT request and updates values in the database.

behaviour: Clicking 'Cancel' resets all inputs to the last saved state and resets unsaved dirty flags.
Clicking 'Save changes' submits updated profile and notification preferences, disabling the button and showing a spinner during submission.
Switching tabs (Profile, Notifications, Billing, Integrations) changes the view or tab panel contents while checking for unsaved changes.
Entering an invalid email address displays an inline field validation message.
Search bar filters project and task suggestions in an overlay dropdown (likely).

backend.summary: Serves user profile and preferences, handles input validation, and writes preference updates to the database.
backend.database: PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM for relational consistency and type safety.
backend.auth: Session cookie verification with NextAuth.js. Requests without a valid session return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

tables.name: users
tables.columns: id uuid pk, full_name varchar(255), email varchar(255) unique, email_due_dates boolean default true, weekly_sprint boolean default false, created_at timestamp, updated_at timestamp

endpoints.purpose: Retrieves the current authenticated user's profile details and notification toggles.
Updates full name, work email, and notification switches for the authenticated user.

rules: Work email must follow standard email format and cannot be empty.
Full name must contain at least 2 characters.
Users can only modify their own settings records.

pitfalls: Not handling unsaved changes when navigating away or switching tabs, resulting in lost user edits.
Forgetting accessibility labels on toggle switches, making them invisible or non-interactive to screen readers.
Changing the email field without verifying whether it conflicts with an existing email in the database.
testing: Verify 'Save changes' submits updated values to /api/user/profile and triggers a success toast.
Verify 'Cancel' button reverts form values back to server-loaded state.
Test keyboard accessibility for toggles using Tab and Space/Enter keys.
Check that invalid email input shows an inline error and prevents API submission.
deploy: Set up a free serverless PostgreSQL database on Neon.tech and copy the connection string.
Set DATABASE_URL and NEXTAUTH_SECRET environment variables in Vercel project settings.
Push the GitHub repository to trigger automatic deployment on Vercel.

tokens.method: Colours: pixel quantisation of the whole screenshot and of each detected element. Font sizes: text box height ÷ 1.25. Spacing: gaps between sibling boxes, snapped to a 4px grid. Measured approximations, not values read from source code.
